title: Counts the number of times each material is used
goal: uses Map keys to accumulate and output key-value pairs in the order of first registration.
summary: scan records multiple uses of the same material. Keep the order in which the materials first appear, and get the number of times each material appears.
tasks: completes countMaterials(names) and adds one to the number of occurrences of each material name.
returns an array in the shape of [[name, times], …]. Arbitrary material names are allowed, including "__proto__".

example.note: Map allows ordinary strings to be used as keys. get returns undefined when reading a key that has not yet been set.

hint: First build a Map and read the old times each time. If there is no Map, it will start from 0. Finally expand the entries into an array.
